g.title: scaler_bicubic
g.text: separable polyphase FIR, TAPS = 4, programmable coefficient tables - any Mitchell-Netravali (B, C) cubic: Catmull-Rom, Mitchell, B-spline, Keys
1 output pixel per clock - pipeline: 10 = 6 + 2*LV stages + output register (LV = 2)
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: regbus
g.text: AW and W in any order, OKAY responses

g.title: ctrl
g.text: capture FSM: SOF / EOL checks, writes the

g.title: dda
g.text: exact accumulation, SOF / EOL / EOF flags
stalls with the pipeline (adv), hold for LINE_BUF

g.title: fb
g.text: 4 x 4 RAM banks (B = 4): a 4x4 window every clock

g.title: tables
g.text: CH: horizontal, 2^PB phases x TAPS 0x1000 + 4*(16*phase + tap)
CV: vertical, 2^PB phases x TAPS 0x2000 + 4*(16*phase + tap)
reset value: bilinear weights; write while idle

g.title: dp
g.text: adder tree, one level per stage
